The Treasure of CrissCross Cove

The Treasure of Crisscross Cove is a GBJam 14 entry by Leafthief and iLKke. 

--- IMPORTANT NOTE! --- 
There has been confusion about longitude/latitude. A clarification: 

  • Same Longitude as thing refers to the same row/Y-Coordinate/left or right of thing
  • Same Latitude as thing refers to the same colum/X-Coordinate/above or below thing

-- CONTROLS -- 

[⬅️][⬆️][➡️][⬇️]  Movement
[Alt][Z][J]/[A] Interact
[Ctrl][K][X]/[B] Dig
[Shift]/[Select] Map
[Return]/[Start] Map

------------------

Captain Songbeard is gone, and you are now in charge of finding his treasure! Each crew member knows only one part of its whereabouts, so you will need to gather all the clues and deduce the correct location. 

And you will need to hurry, as the crew doesn't have time to fool around. 


To help you out, you can print the included map and keep track of all the clues on it.
